services.name: Deluxe Morning Snorkel Marine Life Encounter
Night Manta Ray Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: You will be snorkeling with one of the most graceful creatures in the ocean, manta rays. About After watching one of Kona’s sunsets on the boat ride to the site you’ll slip into the water after dark, with your guide, and snorkel above majestic manta rays as they somersault below you. This will be an awesome story you’ll tell forever! For safety, ALL guests MUST be able to swim 50 yards unassisted, have prior snorkeling experience, and be in good physical and mental health. Kids ages 5+ are welcome if they meet these requirements. Prices vary with demand. Plus tax and fees. Trip Details 2 Hours • Ages 5+ • Year Round

services.name: Captain Cook Monument Kealakekua Bay Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: 4.5 Hours Description Enjoy an exhilarating ride down the Kona coast to snorkel the beautiful calm waters of Kealakekua Bay, where the famous Captain Cook Monument is located. This pristine reef has an abundance of endemic fish (fish found only in Hawaii) and is the perfect place for beginner snorkelers to get hooked on viewing what's under the sea. This is the top-rated snorkel spot on Hawaii island! Inclusions Snacks & Drinks are provided during this trip Mask, snorkels, fins, and additional flotation Details Suitable for ages 3+ 17 & under must be accompanied by a parent/guardian 8:30am or 11:00am • 4 Hours • Ages 3+ • Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri

services.name: Kona Snorkeling in Pawai Bay
services.desc: Skip the crowds at Kealakekua Bay and snorkel our stunning local sites instead - only accessible by boat. With just a 10 - 15 minute boat ride instead of a 45-minute ride, you'll spend more time in the water getting up close and personal with the gorgeous fish on one or two of our lovely local reefs. Less time on the water means more time in the water! Discover the volcanic formations and dramatic arches made by past lava flows. 2.5 hours Our afternoon snorkeling trip takes place in Pawai Bay - ocean permitting - only accessible to guests by boat - that area of coastline 10:00; 1:30pm • 2 Hours • Ages 3+

services.name: Private Morning Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: Group Travel Your Way, The Private Signature Experience About Here at Kona Snorkel Trips, we offer a variety of cool and amazing ocean tours, but sometimes you’ve just got to have things your own way. We understand, and we are here to help you tailor your ocean experience for your family or your group. We bring the boat, the crew, and the fun. You just tell us where you want to go and what you want to do! Want to lounge in the sun on our boat and maybe catch sight of a humpback whale in the distance? – Ditto! We Recommend The Private Signature Experience To… Anyone who wants a unique and 8:30am • 4 Hours • All ages • Up to 18 guests

services.name: Private Afternoon Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: We know that not everyone in the family is a morning person and when you're on vacation you might want to let them sleep in. Charter the boat for those late sleepers and join us in the afternoon for some sun, snorkeling, whale watching (seasonal), and dolphin watching. 2 Hours Inclusions Mask, Snorkel, Fins, additional floatation Requirements Basic swimming skills - must be able to swim or float unassisted This activity is not suitable for those that are pregnant or have back or neck issues due to the adventurous nature of the boat ride. Items to bring Sunprotective shirt GoPro 2 Hours • All Ages • Up to 18 guests

services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: 2 hours Description We’ll spend a couple of hours cruising the coast under the Kona sun looking for these amazing mammals that come to Hawaii to give birth. It's a treat to see these beauties in the clear blue water of Kona. Trip Details Peak whale viewing season is January - Mid March. Suitable for ages 3+ Expectant mothers or those with back or neck issues are not permitted on this tour due to the adventurous nature of this retired navy seal boat Additional Info Bring sun-protective clothing Camera with zoom lens Binoculars (available for (Seasonal; Late Dec - March) 8:00am (Tue, Thu); 1:30pm (Sat) • 2 Hours • Ages 3+
